title: Multi-document YAML load via yaml.load_all (python) — review required
description: The python call yaml.load_all parses every document in a YAML stream with the default loader, which can construct arbitrary Python objects. Each document multiplies the exposure. Use yaml.safe_load_all. This lexical rule flags the call; whether Loader was set is reviewed separately.
remediation: Use yaml.safe_load_all, or pass the safe loader explicitly for every document.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the yaml.load_all call; a safe Loader argument on the same call is visible but not proven.
